name: 食べられる食品と対応範囲を設定する
prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. ONE complete compact Japanese Lighthouse food-preference panel LH19-0025, portrait on purewhite#FFFFFF.
Image1 ORIGINAL BlueApron highest authority for switch geometry, knobproportions, alignedgrid, checkboxsquare, controlstates, spacing and fine detail. Image2 full Japanese mock SECONDARY wording/layout; image3 nested Japanese grid SECONDARY detail. Image4 approved Lighthouse whitecard/forestgradient style only.
Exact title「食事の好み」MeiryoBold20/28. Full regular14/24 paragraph, wrap naturally at logicalphonewidth390 without clipping:
「食べられる食品を選んでください。選んだ内容を献立の提案に使います。個別の食物アレルギーには対応していません。」
Preserve this unsupported-individual-allergy limitation explicitly, never claim allergy-safe/certified.
Two-column,3-row grid with fine neutral rules and aligned labels/switches:
row1「豚肉」ON,「牛肉」OFF
row2「羊肉」OFF,「貝類」OFF
row3「魚」ON,「鶏肉」ON.
Final halfwidth row underleft「ベジタリアン」and UNCHECKED square checkbox, right areaempty. Do not invent additionalfoodgroups, checkboxcheck or a mergedfullrow.
Source ON knobsRIGHT, OFF knobsLEFT. Preserve original precise knob/track geometry. Adapt greenON to subtleforestgradient#174C36→#1F6444→#2D8F5E; original redOFF becomes neutralgray under officialstyle, OFF is preference state noterror. Whiteknobs, sourcecheckbox shape with quietslateoutline, no randomicons.
Below exact statement「次回以降の献立から、牛肉・羊肉・貝類の料理を除きます。」, then forest-gradient primary「更新する」with legiblewhitelabel, modestroundedshape/softshadow.
Locked MeiryoRegular14/24body,12/16metadata,tracking0; existing compact roles/wrapping. Whitecard/surfaces, neutralborders, mainink#1D1D1D/secondary#6E6E6E, restrainedpadding/elevation. All6switches/checkbox/text/actionvisible, no broadmint/nesteddecorativecards/gloss/extraUI/chatbubble/watermark. Noactualbackendmutation or allergyguarantee is implied.
reviewNotes: 原本・全体モック・入れ子一覧・各編集状態を実見。豚肉／魚／鶏肉ON、牛肉／羊肉／貝類OFF、ベジタリアン未選択、個別食物アレルギー非対応の全文、3食品を除く文と更新操作を確認。原本優先のtrack/knob位置と表の形を保持、ONと更新は森林色、OFF赤は公式基準のneutralgrayへ適応。日本語の欠けなし。厳密フォント数値・除外の実連動・所有者承認・ネイティブ編集・アプリ動作は未認定。
reviewNotice: 画像生成候補。ネイティブ編集・実装・所有者承認とは別です。
